Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is all we have from this first T20I. It was quite an entertaining encounter and we can expect more of the same in the second T20I. That game is on Thursday, 28th of July. It will start at 11 pm IST (5.30 pm GMT). Our build-up though begins in advance. So do join us for the same. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Moeen Ali is awarded the Player of the Match award for his performance with bat and ball. He says that it worked nicely today. He went up the order to keep the right and left-hand combination. Tells that he backs himself against the spinner and adds that he does not think much about the side the ball turns and just goes after it. Says that Jonny Bairstow is a powerful hitter of the ball and he generally has good partnerships with him. Talks about his batting and says that he is not a massive hitter of the ball like some guys and he just tries to hold his shape and go for his shots.

Jos Buttler, the skipper of England says that it was a great performance and the boys stood up. Credits Jonny Bairstow and says that the boys played brilliantly and he is happy to win this game. Tells that it is fantastic to see the boys stepping up and says that it is great to have Jonny Bairstow back in the team. Adds that Moeen Ali is the most stylish player and he would like to give him more responsibility and he has some great abilities. Mentions that both Richard Gleeson and Chris Jordan bowled with good pace and that the 18th over from Chris Jordan was a game-changer. Tells that margins are very short in the T20 game and it is all about execution, especially on the ground like this.

South Africa's captain David Miller says that the ball was traveling around and it was a great wicket and the boys showed a lot of fight. He credits Tristan Stubbs for his knock and says that it shows the kind of talent they have in South Africa. Tells that they did not bowl well in the last 10 overs and England executed quite well at the backend. Says that Tristan Stubbs is a clean striker of the ball and says that he hopes that he can continue it for a long time. Applauds Lungi Ngidi for the way he bowled and adds that it was a phenomenal effort from him.
Time for the presentation....

Earlier, England put on a wonderful batting performance on the back of half-centuries from Jonny Bairstow and Moeen Ali. They put on a massive target and looked like they would easily defend it at the halfway stage. Lungi Ngidi took five wickets but it has come for a losing cause. South Africa will be truly disappointed with their fielding effort today. They dropped way too many catches and let England off the hook. They will look to come back strongly in the next game.

England on the other hand started off really well taking a couple of early wickets. Reece Topley continued his good form taking two wickets and being really economical. Richard Gleeson was expensive but contributed with three crucial wickets. The spinners picked three wickets between them and overall it was a good bowling performance by the English bowlers in a small ground and on a batting wicket. The game was still up for grabs with 54 runs required of the last three overs but a wonderful over from Chris Jordan where he conceded just 3 runs all but ended South Africa's hopes of a win.

South Africa had their task cut out chasing this massive total and did not get off to the best of starts losing Quinton de Kock and Rilee Rossouw early in the chase. Reeza Hendricks and Heinrich Klaasen put up a good recovery partnership with the former getting to his half-century. However, both departed soon and with the loss of their skipper David Miller they found themselves in deep trouble. It was the blitz from Tristan Stubbs that provided a glimmer of hope for the South Africans as he reached his maiden half-century. But once he departed on 72 of just 28 deliveries all hope was lost for the visitors.

What a game we have witnessed here! England have taken the lead in this three-match series after a bit of a scare but the target of 235 proved way too much for the Proteas. They fought hard but have fallen short of the England total by 41 runs.

That's it! England win this high-scoring game! This is a yorker-length delivery on off. Maharaj manages to dig it out off the inside half of his blade towards the leg side. He takes a single and it is England who win this game by 41 runs!
Back of a length, outside off. Keshav Maharaj throws his bat at it but misses.
Angling into leg. Almost a yorker again. Lungi Ngidi looks to clip it away but misses. The ball brushes his pads and rolls towards the leg side. A leg bye taken.
A length delivery on off. Keshav Maharaj slaps it to long off for a single.
A fullish delivery on middle. Lungi Ngidi works it to mid-wicket for a single.
A full toss on off. Keshav Maharaj knocks it down to long off for a single.
Lungi Ngidi is the new batter at the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! Richard Gleeson gets his third wicket and after bowling three expensive over, he manages to get three wickets in his final over! A low full toss on the pads. Andile Phehlukwayo flicks and flicks it aerially towards Adil Rashid at square leg. He takes a fine catch and England are just two wickets away now and this over has sealed the deal for England.
Commentary.Howout: c Adil Rashid b Richard Gleeson

Commentary.Commentary: A length delivery on off. Keshav Maharaj hits it to long off for a single.
Keshav Maharaj makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! KNOCKED HIM OVER! Richard Gleeson goes full on leg. Rabada looks to drive it away. However, he ends up playing it completely down the wrong line and the ball knocks over the leg pole. Richard Gleeson gets his second wicket of the over.
On a length, on middle. Andile Phehlukwayo works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A fuller delivery on the pads. Andile Phehlukwayo flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.

OUT! CAUGHT! That's the end of Stubbs and probably the end of South Africa's chance of winning this game. This is full and outside off. Stubbs looks to hit it down the ground. However, he fails to get under it and ends up hitting it straight to Roy at long off. End of a fantastic knock from this talented youngster. Kagiso Rabada is the next man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Roy b Richard Gleeson

Commentary.Commentary: Another dot delivery and just 3 from this over! South Africa now need 51 runs from 12 balls! A wide yorker outside off again and Andile Phehlukwayo fails to dig it out.
Another superb delivery! It is another perfect yorker outside off. Andile Phehlukwayo looks to reverse-scoops it but misses.
Nails a perfect yorker again. It is wider outside off and Andile Phehlukwayo fails to get a bat on it.
Just three singles from this over so far! A fuller delivery on middle. Stubbs heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Brilliant yorker from Jordan! On middle and all Andile Phehlukwayo could do there was to dig it out towards the off side for a single.

So just a single to start the over! A low full toss, outside off. Stubbs looks to hit it towards the off side. However, he gets the inside edge and the ball goes past stumps left of the keeper. A single taken.
Single to end the over and Stubbs will retain the strike! 54 needed now from 18 balls! This is a good wide yorker. Stubbs digs it out behind square on the off side for a single.
A full delivery on middle. Andile Phehlukwayo drills it to long on for a single.
Just a single! Better from Curran! He goes wider outside off. It is a low full toss but Stubbs gets only the toe-end of his blade as the ball rolls towards covers. A single taken.
SIX! Oh, my word! This man is playing a gem of an innings! A very full delivery on middle. Stubbs goes deep in his crease and whips it over the square leg fence for a maximum.
A low full toss on leg. Andile Phehlukwayo mistimes it to long off for a single.
Dot ball! Nails a yorker, on middle on leg. Right in the blockhole and Andile Phehlukwayo gets his bat down in time.

SIX! Wow! What an innings this young man is playing! This is short on off. Stubbs goes deep in his crease and flat-bats it straight down the ground for a biggie. 64 needed now from 24 balls! Stubbs has kept South Africa in this game almost single-handedly.
Bangs it short on off. Stubbs looks to pull it but gets a top edge this time. The ball falls short and wide of the long on fielder for a couple.
FOUR! Class written all over it! This is full on the pads. Stubbs flicks it through backward square leg for a boundary.
This is fuller on off. Andile Phehlukwayo drives it to mid off for a boundary.
FOUR! Back-to back boundaries! Tad shorter and around off. Andile Phehlukwayo makes a bit of room and slaps it over mid off for a boundary.
FOUR! That's a good start to the final five overs for South Africa! This is full on leg at 89 mph. Andile Phehlukwayo just tucks it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Richard Gleeson is back on. He has gone for 26 runs in his two overs!
This is on a good length and just outside off, Andile Phehlukwayo knocks this down to long on for a single.

What a brilliant fifty from Tristan Stubbs as he reaches his maiden half-century at a very useful time for South Africa! Reece Topley goes full and outside off stump. Tristan Stubbs drags this to the leg side and gets across to complete a well compiled half-century! Gets it off just 19 deliveries with the help of 6 big hits!
Reece Topley serves this full and wide outside off, Tristan Stubbs looks to cut and misses as it beats his outside edge!

SIX! Tristan Stubbs is dealing in maximums here! Reece Topley bangs this in short and angles this away from the rigt-hander. Tristan Stubbs gets a hold of this as he pulls this over the deep mid-wicket fence for another huge hit! Tristan Stubbs is putting up quite a fight and is just a run away from his fifty!
Serves this a fraction short and angling into the batter. Andile Phehlukwayo pulls it to deep square leg and gets a single.

FOUR! Andile Phehlukwayo has timed this one well! Reece Topley serves this full and well outside off stump. Andile Phehlukwayo gets his bat to it and guides it to the right of mid off as the ball runs towards the deep cover boundary for four runs.
Reece Topley is back for his last over. He has taken two wickets in his three overs so far.
Adil Rashid goes full outside off, Andile Phehlukwayo looks to work this leg side and gets a leading edge towards point for a single.
Andile Phehlukwayo is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! The skipper departs and South Africa are five down! Adil Rashid fires this one full outside off, David Miller looks to clear long off but does not get good enough connection. Chris Jordan takes a wonderful catch diving forward and makes it look really easy. This game seems to be slipping out of South Africa's hands.
Commentary.Howout: c Chris Jordan b Adil Rashid

Commentary.Commentary: This is short as well and angling into the pads, Tristan Stubbs goes on the backfoot and works it to deep square leg for a single.

SIX! What a hit! Tristan Stubbs seems to have arrived! Adil Rashid floats this one full on middle and leg, Tristan Stubbs gets on one knee and thumps this over deep square leg to add another maximum to his kitty! What an innings this is proving to be!
FOUR! Tristan Stubbs is playing quite an innings here! Adil Rashid bowls this a fraction short and outside off, Tristan Stubbs makes room and thumps it between deep cover and long off for a boundary!
Adil Rashid begins with a full delivery on middle and off, Tristan Stubbs knocks it back to the bowler.
Adil Rashid is back into the attack. One over for five runs and a wicket so far for Rashid.
This is full and outside off, Tristan Stubbs strokes this towards deep cover-point for a single.
SIX! Tristan Stubbs gets his fourth maximum! Chris Jordan serves this on a length and outside off. Sits up nicely for Tristan Stubbs to pull this over the deep mid-wicket fence for six more runs!
On a good length and outside off, David Miller guides this to deep point for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Stubbs dabs it towards the off side for a single.
This is on a good length and in line with the stumps, Tristan Stubbs makes room and fends it back to the bowler.
Chris Jordan goes 'round the wicket and fires this down leg, David Miller looks to work this leg side and the ball clips his pads and they get a leg bye.
Chris Jordan is back on. He went for 14 runs in his first over!

Make that three sixes in an over for Tristan Stubbs! Moeen Ali flights this full outside off, Tristan Stubbs has room to swing his arms. Gets this high and handsome over the deep cover boundary for another maximum! Tristan Stubbs is looking really good and Moeen Ali has conceded 22 runs in this over!
This is bowled full and angling into the left-hander. David Miller guides this towards long on for a single.
Fired full outside off, Tristan Stubbs hits this towards cover and gets across for a run.

SIX! Back-to-back biggies! This one is even bigger!  Moeen Ali serves this full and angling down leg, Tristan Stubbs makes room and slogs the ball over the mid-wicket boundary for another six runs! Tristan Stubbs is showing why he is so highly rated!
SIX! That maximum brings up the 100 for South Africa! Moeen Ali looks to go full but bowls a full toss as it is thumped straight over the long on fielder for a biggie!
Full delivery on middle and leg, Tristan Stubbs taps it with soft hands towards mid-wicket and rushes across for a brace.
Reece Topley serves this on a good length outside off, David Miller swings hard and misses as the ball beats his outside edge.
This is full outside off, Tristan Stubbs strokes this wide of mid off and takes a run.
Reece Topley bowls this on a good length and follows the batter, David Miller looks to make room and cant work it away. Gets hit on the pads and he takes a single leg bye.
This is on a good length and just outside off, David Miller plays inside the line of the ball and gets beaten on the outside edge. Just misses the off pole as well.
On a good length and angling into the pads, David Miller clips this to deep backward square leg. A misfield allows the batters to take two runs.
Reece Topley begins with a full delivery wide outside off, Tristan Stubbs works this to deep point for a single.
On the shorter side, on middle. Stubbs pulls it to short fine leg for a single.
Tad shorter on middle. Miller works it towards the leg side for a single.
Tristan Stubbs comes out to the middle and he has to build a partnership with his skipper if South Africa wants to get anywhere close to this target.

OUT! CAUGHT! Reeza Hendricks departs and Moeen Ali strikes in his first over! Soouth Africa still need 149 from 62 balls and it looks a tough task for them from hereon. This is floated up on middle. Reeza Hendricks gets under it and tries to loft it towards the leg side. However, he does not get the power required behind this shot and ends up hitting it straight to Sam Curran at deep mid-wicket. Big wicket this and England are right on top here!
Commentary.Howout: c Sam Curran b Moeen Ali

Commentary.Commentary: This is fuller on off. Miller drives it to covers for a single.
A tossed up delivery on middle. Reeza Hendricks drives it down the ground for a single.
Pushed quicker on middle. Miller works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Moeen Ali has been brought into the attack.
FOUR! Finds the gap again! Back of a length, outside off. Reeza Hendricks cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
On a length, angling into leg. Reeza Hendricks looks to tuck it away but misses.
Bangs it short on off. Reeza Hendricks sways away from the line of the ball.

FOUR! Fifty for Reeza Hendricks! He was a bit slow to get off the blocks but he has made up for it with some breathtaking strokeplay once he found his touch. On the shorter side, on middle. Reeza Hendricks pulls it to deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Back of a length, around off. Reeza Hendricks punches it past point and puts in a dive to make his ground as he comes back for the second run.
On a length, on middle. Miller turns it towards the leg side for a single.
The skipper, David Miller walks out to the middle. South Africa will be hoping for a captain's knock. Sam Curran has been brought back into the attack.

OUT! CAUGHT! Adil Rashid strikes and gets rid of Heinrich Klaasen! Rashid keeps his length short again. It is on middle and Heinrich Klaasen rocks back to pull it. However, he does not get the middle of his blade and ends up hitting it straight down the throat of the fielder at long on. Jordan there takes an easy catch and South Africa lose their third wicket now.
Commentary.Howout: c Chris Jordan b Adil Rashid

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter in length on middle. Reeza Hendricks pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A tossed up delivery on off. Heinrich Klaasen makes room and lofts it just short of long off for a single.
Bowls it short on middle. Reeza Hendricks pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Goes fuller on middle. Heinrich Klaasen backs away and pushes it to long on for a single.
A flatter delivery on off. Reeza Hendricks looks to punch it towards the off side. However, he gets the inside edge to short fine leg for a single.

FOUR! Boundary to end the over and that makes it another very good over for the Proteas. 17 off it. 168 needed now from 78 balls! On the shorter side on off. Heinrich Klaasen picks the length quickly and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Goes fuller again and it is around off at 145 kph. Reeza Hendricks drives it to covers for a single.
A fullish delivery on middle. Heinrich Klaasen drives it down the ground for a single.
FOUR! Heinrich Klaasen gets into the act now! This is touch fuller on off. Heinrich Klaasen drills it wide of mid off for a boundary.
A pacy back-of-a-length delivery angling into the body at 147 kph. Reeza Hendricks just about manages to defend it towards the off side and takes a single.
SIX! That is another quality shot! Serves it just short of good length on middle. Reeza Hendricks just helps it on its way as he hits it way over the square leg fence for a maximum.

Chris Jordan goes full once again and into the pads, Heinrich Klaasen looks to clip this leg side and misses as the ball hits his pads and rolls back towards the bowler. 14 runs of the over. South Africa are 50/2 after the Powerplay.

FOUR! The third one of the over! That brings up the 50 for South Africa! Chris Jordan serves this full and angling down leg, Heinrich Klaasen gets some bat on this as the ball runs away to the fine leg boundary for four valuable runs. This is proving to be a good over for South Africa and they will be hoping to get a move on from here.
Chris Jordan serves a slower ball full and follows the batter as he looks to make room. Reeza Hendricks gets an inside edge onto his pads and takes a single as the ball rolls over to the offside.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Chris Jordan serves this on a length and in line with the stumps, Reeza Hendricks makes room and pulls it over the infield towards the deep mid-wicket boundary for four more runs!
FOUR! That is straight as an arrow! Chris Jordan goes full on middle and off, Reeza Hendricks clears his front foot out of the way and hits it straight over the bowlers head for four runs!
Chris Jordan begins with a yorker in line with the stumps. Heinrich Klaasen gets his bat down in time and gets a single to deep backward point.
Chris Jordan is into the attack now.
Tad shorter again, on off. Reeza Hendricks dabs it towards the off side this time. 9 runs from the over!
FOUR! Nicely timed! Back of a length, around off. Rassie van der Dussen gets on the top of the bounce and cuts it through point for a boundary.
A fuller delivery on middle. Reeza Hendricks drives it to mid on.

FOUR! Edged but it races away towards the third man fence. Lands on a good length, around off. It zips off the surface and Reeza Hendricks gets an outside edge as he looks to work it towards the leg side. The ball runs away for a boundary.
Back of a length, around off. Reeza Hendricks swings across the line but misses.

Serves it on a length, on middle. Heinrich Klaasen looks to work it towards the leg side but misses. The ball hits Klassen high on the pads and the ball goes over the stumps and off the bounce to the keeper.
Back of a length, on off. Heinrich Klaasen pushes it to mid off for a single.
This is full and outside off,  Reeza Hendricks guides this to deep point for a run.
This is short and quick outside off, Heinrich Klaasen gets this through cover-point for a single.
This is a fraction short outside off, Reeza Hendricks looks to fend and gets an inside edge towards square leg for a single.
Reece Topley serves this on a good length outside off, Reeza Hendricks taps this towards the cover fielder.

FOUR! What an elegant shot from Reeza Hendricks! Reece Topley goes full outside off, Reeza Hendricks gets his front foot forward and thumps the ball between cover and mid off for a lovely boundary! Reeza Hendricks is looking good here and a lot will depend on him.
This is back of a length and outside off, Reeza Hendricks guides this to deep point for a single.
FOUR! Second boundary of the over! Sam Curran serves this full outside off and allows Reeza Hendricks to free his hands as he lifts this over the mid off fielder for another boundary!
This is short as well, and outside off, Reeza Hendricks gets on his toes and works this through cover for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Up and over! Lands on a length and outside off. Reeza Hendricks stays still in his crease and lifts it over mid off for a boundary.
This is slightly short and outside off, Heinrich Klaasen guides this past point for a single.
This is on a good length and outside off, Heinrich Klaasen looks to play this through the off side and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Heinrich Klaasen walks out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rilee Rossouw's stay at the wicket does not last too long! Reece Topley goes short outside off and gets the ball to shape away a bit. Rilee Rossouw goes for the pull shot and gets a top edge that flies towards third man. Richard Gleeson comes running in from the deep and takes a fine catch. South Africa in serious trouble now!
Commentary.Howout: c Richard Gleeson b Reece Topley

Commentary.Commentary: Goes a fraction short outside off, Rilee Rossouw mistimes his pull towards mid on.
FOUR! Rilee Rossouw has powered this away! Reece Topley serves this on a length and outside off, Rilee Rossouw pulls this to the deep mid-wicket boundary for four runs! Rilee Rossouw is on his way!
This is a fraction full and angling into the stumps, Rilee Rossouw looks to work the leg side and gets a leading edge towards cover.
Rilee Rossouw is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Quinton de Kock perishes early and England have begun well! Reece Topley serves this a fraction short of good length and outside off. Quinton de Kock slashes hard at it and straight to the cover fielder. Dawid Malan takes the catch with ease and England celebrate their early wicket!
Commentary.Howout: c Dawid Malan b Reece Topley

Commentary.Commentary: Reece Topley begins with a good-length delivery outside off. Quinton de Kock looks to cut this but only manages to under edge it back down towards the keeper.
Reece Topley to start from the other end.
Sam Curran delivers this wide outside off on a fuller length. Reeza Hendricks mistimes his shot once again towards mid on.
Low full toss once again outside the off pole. Quinton de Kock knocks this towards mid on and takes a run.
This on is on a good length and outside off, Reeza Hendricks guides this past point for a single.
Sam Curran serves this full outside off, Reeza Hendricks looks to play this straight and mistimes it towards mid-wicket.
This is a quick full toss outside off, Reeza Hendricks fends this towards the cover fielder.
Sam Curran begins with a full outswinger pitching outside off, Quinton de Kock taps it towards mid on and rushes across for a single.
